    """

    feasible = remaining >= 0

    deviation_from_median = np.abs(remaining - median_remaining)
    normalized_deviation = deviation_from_median / (np.max(remaining) + 1e-8)
    priority_scores = np.where(feasible, 1 / (1 + normalized_deviation), -np.inf)
